headline: SDP @ WSN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SDP 3.50 at WSN 3.75, with a projected total of 7.25. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward WSN: SDP moved -2.17 runs while WSN moved -0.59, changing the projected margin by -1.58 runs. The projected total fell -2.76, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -16.5%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Paxton Schultz has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for James Wood, Fernando Tatis Jr., Gavin Sheets, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags José Tena because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
